title: Quick Fix Kicked Uruguayan Galangal Grill
description: A spicy, pillowy Uruguayan dish made with grilled galangal, beef and vegetables, served in a mason jar.
instructions: Grill the galangal over medium heat for 2 minutes per side, or until slightly charred.
Grill the flank steak over medium-high heat for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked to your liking.
Slice the steak into thin strips and set aside.
Add the chili peppers to the grill and cook for 1-2 minutes per side, or until slightly softened.
Add the cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper to the grill and cook for 1 minute.
Combine the grilled galangal, steak, chili peppers, and spices in a large bowl.
Spoon the mixture into the mason jar and serve immediately.
Garnish with fresh cilantro or scallions, if desired.
